nights.title: Fruit Bats
nights.name: Fruit Bats
nights.extract: Fruit Bats is an American indie rock band formed in 1997 in Chicago, Illinois, as the project of singer and songwriter Eric D. Johnson. Johnson is the band's sole permanent member, with various musicians joining the band in live and studio settings.

en.who: Fruit Bats is an American indie rock project led by singer and songwriter Eric D. Johnson. Johnson is the only permanent member, and other musicians join for live and studio work.
facts: The band was formed in 1997 in Chicago, Illinois.
Eric D. Johnson is the band's sole permanent member.

de.who: Fruit Bats ist ein amerikanisches Indie-Rock-Projekt unter Leitung des Sängers und Songwriters Eric D. Johnson. Johnson ist das einzige feste Mitglied, andere Musiker stoßen für Live- und Studioarbeit dazu.
facts: Die Band wurde 1997 in Chicago, Illinois, gegründet.
Eric D. Johnson ist das einzige dauerhafte Mitglied der Band.

tr.who: Fruit Bats, şarkıcı ve söz yazarı Eric D. Johnson'ın önderliğindeki Amerikan indie rock projesidir. Johnson tek kalıcı üyedir; canlı ve stüdyo çalışmalarına başka müzisyenler katılır.
facts: Grup 1997'de Chicago, Illinois'de kuruldu.
Eric D. Johnson, grubun tek kalıcı üyesidir.

nights.title: Josie Edwards
nights.name: Josie Edwards
nights.extract: Josie Edwards is an American musician and songwriter. She is best known for her 2026 single “Chemical Light", as well as her 2025 hit “good girls”. She has released two EPs and performed at All Points East as a supporting act for Twenty One Pilots alongside Gang of Youths, Bbno$, and Jessie Murph.

nights.title: Georgia Brass Band
nights.name: Georgia Brass Band
nights.extract: The Georgia Brass Band was conceived by co-founders Joe Johnson and Christopher Priest in the spring of 1999. It is a traditional British-style brass band. The band performed its first concert in September 1999 and has maintained a very busy schedule ever since.

en.who: The Georgia Brass Band is a traditional British-style brass band, conceived by co-founders Joe Johnson and Christopher Priest. It gave its first concert in September 1999 and has kept a busy schedule ever since.

nights.title: Doja Cat - Tour Ma Vie World Tour
nights.name: Doja Cat
nights.extract: Amala Ratna Zandile Dlamini, known professionally as Doja Cat, is an American rapper and singer-songwriter. Regarded as the "Queen of Pop-Rap", she is known for her musical versatility, live performance skills and humorous internet presence. Billboard named her "one of the world's biggest pop stars" and "one of the defining pop stars of this era", and Time listed her as one of the world's most influential people in 2023.

nights.title: I Set My Friends On Fire
nights.name: I Set My Friends on Fire
nights.extract: I Set My Friends on Fire is an American post-hardcore band from Miami, Florida. The band was formed in 2007 by Matt Mehana and Nabil Moo. The group signed with Epitaph Records before releasing their debut album, You Can't Spell Slaughter Without Laughter, in 2008. Drummer Chris Lent joined the band in 2009. The group's second album, Astral Rejection, was scheduled to be released on June 22, 2010, but it was shelved for a year by Epitaph. Moo left the band in 2010, then Lent left the band. The group's third album, Caterpillar Sex, was announced in 2013 but has never seen a release.

en.who: I Set My Friends on Fire is an American post-hardcore band from Miami, Florida, formed in 2007 by Matt Mehana and Nabil Moo. The band signed with Epitaph Records before releasing its debut album.
facts: The band was formed in 2007 by Matt Mehana and Nabil Moo.
Their debut album, You Can't Spell Slaughter Without Laughter, came out in 2008.

de.who: I Set My Friends on Fire ist eine amerikanische Post-Hardcore-Band aus Miami, Florida, gegründet 2007 von Matt Mehana und Nabil Moo. Die Band unterschrieb bei Epitaph Records, bevor sie ihr Debütalbum veröffentlichte.
facts: Matt Mehana und Nabil Moo gründeten die Band 2007.
Ihr Debütalbum You Can't Spell Slaughter Without Laughter erschien 2008.

nights.title: The Paradox
nights.name: The Paradox
nights.extract: The Paradox is an American pop-punk band from Atlanta, Georgia, formed in 2024. Its members are Eric Dangerfield, Donald Bryant (bass), Christopher "Xelan" Bernard, and Percy "PC3" Crews (drums). They are the first all-black punk band to be number 1 on Billboard's Alternative Airplay chart.
